answer: Newly minted rewards stay unspendable for 16 epochs in a grove vault, with clawback live until release. Any established key may post a 600 POA challenge bond plus pointers into a public mirror of funding-cluster tags. A random three-key panel either burns the accused unvested stock and pays the challenger from that burn, or forfeits the 600 POA to the accused. An operator with 80 cheap keys behind one willow host cannot cash out at the next close; one upheld linkage can erase every unvested unit in the cluster, so capital at risk rises with recent issuance, not with a flat per-key bond.
